# Reviewed

> Reviewed provides unbiased, lab-tested product reviews and buying guides across appliances, smart home, kitchen, and cooking categories.

Reviewed is a comprehensive product review site specializing in expert testing and comparisons of major appliances, kitchen gadgets, small appliances, and smart home devices. The site combines hands-on testing with detailed buying guides to help consumers make informed purchasing decisions.

## Key Topics

- product reviews
- expert testing
- buying guides
- kitchen appliances
- smart home
- dishwashers
- refrigerators
- washers and dryers
- air fryers
- ovens and ranges
- small appliances
- product comparisons
- how-to guides
- home improvement
- Honeywell, Maytag, Speed Queen

## Major Appliances Reviews

- [Appliances Reviews, Features, and Deals](https://www.reviewed.com/appliances): Main appliances category hub with reviews for fridges, dishwashers, washers, and dryers.
- [Dishwashers Reviews, Features, and Deals](https://www.reviewed.com/dishwashers): Comprehensive dishwasher reviews and buying guide with product comparisons.
- [Refrigerators Reviews, Features, and Deals](https://www.reviewed.com/refrigerators): Refrigerator reviews covering French door, side-by-side, and other types.
- [Ovens & Ranges Reviews, Features, and Deals](https://www.reviewed.com/ovens): Oven and range reviews including gas, electric, induction, and convection models.
- [Laundry Reviews, Features, and Deals](https://www.reviewed.com/laundry): Washer and dryer reviews covering top load, front load, and stackable options.

## Kitchen & Cooking

- [Kitchen & Cooking Reviews, Features, and Deals](https://www.reviewed.com/cooking): Kitchen and cooking hub with reviews of appliances, cookware, and gadgets.
- [Small Appliances Reviews, Features, and Deals](https://www.reviewed.com/small-appliances): Small appliance reviews including air fryers, coffee makers, and blenders.
- [Here's how to use a food dehydrator to make snacks at home](https://www.reviewed.com/cooking/features/heres-how-to-use-a-food-dehydrator-to-make-your-own-snacks): How-to guide on using food dehydrators like Excalibur to make homemade snacks.

## Smart Home & Connected Devices

- [Honeywell Home X8S Smart Thermostat Review](https://www.reviewed.com/smarthome/content/honeywell-home-x8s-smart-thermostat-review): Expert review of Honeywell Home X8S smart thermostat with Ring doorbell integration.

## Home

- [Product Reviews, Features, and Deals - Reviewed](https://www.reviewed.com): Homepage offering unbiased, lab-tested product reviews across smart home, kitchen, and appliances.
